entry.author: Environment Southland
entry.summary:
Many Southlanders have been discussing our independently reviewed financial modelling, released as part of the Murihiku Southland amalgamation conversation.

It's encouraging to see people taking the time to understand the details and engage with the information being shared.

To support informed discussion, a report that underpins this financial modelling is now available to read - https://www.es.govt.nz/about-us/government-reform/southland-amalgamation-financial-model.

Hear more on the report and its release from Chair Jeremy McPhail.
